_about: Data for the combined station js/cook/stations/roll-tawa.js (lab-only proof). `station` is its name and goal line (merged into data.stations); `mechanic.levels` are its difficulty levels: here, which level each zone's mechanic runs at (tawa level 2 = two tawas).

station.name: Roll and cook
station.goal: Roll each maani on the board. It goes to the tawa: flip it on the green while you roll the next.
